E1.evidence: Issue #113 (maintainer-filed, duplicated as #114) includes the build log: "/opt/ros/rolling/include/cv_bridge/cv_bridge/cv_bridge.h:42:2: warning: #warning This header is obsolete, please include cv_bridge/cv_bridge.hpp instead [-Wcpp]" (https://github.com/ros-perception/image_transport_plugins/issues/113). PR #112's CI was affected: "PR failing due to #113" (https://github.com/ros-perception/image_transport_plugins/pull/112#issuecomment-1308081675).

E2.evidence: cv_bridge (vision_opencv) renamed its public header cv_bridge/cv_bridge.h to cv_bridge/cv_bridge.hpp and turned the .h file into a deprecated forwarding shim (PR #448, "Deprecate .h files in favor of .hpp headers"). compressed_depth_image_transport (image_transport_plugins), a separately released package, still includes cv_bridge/cv_bridge.h. The fix changes the consumer's source includes to follow the provider's renamed header. That is an interface change the consumer must follow, not a build-system-only change (step 4 does not apply).

E3.evidence: UPGRADE: the provider is the rolling cv_bridge release installed in /opt/ros/rolling (3.4.0 per rosdistro on the report date), which contains the deprecation from PR #448 (first released in 3.3.0). The consumer source still names the header as it existed before PR #448.

E4.evidence: Observed compiler warning at build, repeated for two consumer translation units (compressed_depth_publisher.cpp:36 and codec.cpp:40) in the log in issue #113.

notes: Outcome: the reporter (the package maintainer) calls this a 'Build failure', but the primary log shows only a warning, followed by "Finished <<< compressed_depth_image_transport [39.0s]". The package built. CI treated the warning as a failure ("PR failing due to #113"; later "Merging, as CI failure is unrelated."). Following the primary source, the outcome is warning_only. Class: the header was renamed (.h -> .hpp) and the old name kept as a deprecated forwarding shim. It was removed later (vision_opencv 5d6148ab, 2023-10-12, 'remove header files that were deprecated in I-turtle'), and at that point this consumer revision would fail to compile. consumer_built_against.broken is c75d4095, the first parent of PR #448's merge commit fa5213bb on the ros2 (rolling) branch: the last provider revision in which cv_bridge/cv_bridge.h was the real header rather than the shim. The newest numbered rolling-line tag before it is 3.0.3. The inferred span c75d4095..3.4.0 also contains other provider changes (first-parent merges of PRs #471, #480, #479, #478, #491, #493 and the 3.3.0/3.3.1/3.4.0 release commits). The consumer uses cv_bridge only through the listed symbols in codec.cpp. Other compositions fixed by the same PR: compressed_image_transport (compressed_publisher.cpp, compressed_subscriber.cpp) and theora_image_transport (theora_publisher.h, theora_subscriber.cpp) include the same deprecated header; their build output is not shown in the source.
